Another interesting facet of art appreciation is sensitivity to wordless things that are hard to quantify. For example, I can appreciate Rothko (though I'm not a raving fanboy and don't think his paintings deserve such a high price). So I think that can come into play too, when it comes to appreciating art. One can try to break down these reactions intellectually - golden mean, complimentary colors, etc - but I don't believe this really gets to the heart of the matter.
